pages.bodyCopy:
Finding Comfort Before Baby Arrives

Late pregnancy can feel extra heavy on hot Bountiful afternoons. Swollen feet, an aching back, and trouble finding a comfy sleep position can make even simple errands or walking kids to school feel like a workout. Trying to stay active, keep up with family, and prepare for baby all at once can leave your body begging for relief.

Two of the most common natural ways to feel better are prenatal chiropractic care and prenatal massage. Both focus on comfort, both are gentle, and both can be adapted to your changing body. The big question is which one fits what you are feeling right now, and when it makes sense to use both together.

In this article, we will walk through how pregnancy changes your body, what a prenatal chiropractor in Bountiful does, how prenatal massage helps, and simple ways to choose the right care for your needs. Our goal is to help you feel more at ease as you move through these last weeks before baby arrives.

How Pregnancy Changes Your Body and Comfort Needs

Pregnancy shifts almost everything about how you move and stand. As your belly grows, your center of gravity moves forward. Many people lean back without noticing, which can strain the low back, hips, and neck. Your body also releases relaxin, a hormone that makes ligaments looser so your pelvis can open for birth. Looser ligaments can mean joints feel less stable, especially around the low back and pelvis.

On top of that, everyday life in Utah can be pretty active. You might be:

Walking neighborhood hills or local trails

Standing at kids’ games or practices

Bending, lifting, and turning while doing chores

Getting up and down from the floor with other little ones

These things can be good for circulation and mood, but they can also flare up low back pain, hip discomfort, or pelvic pressure when your body is already working harder.

This is why “regular” bodywork is often not enough in pregnancy. Prenatal care needs a different approach, including:

Safe positioning that does not put pressure on your belly

Trimester-specific awareness, like when lying flat is not a good idea

Gentle techniques that respect loose joints and sensitive areas

An understanding of how rapid changes, heat, and extra activity affect you

Choosing providers who are trained to work with pregnant patients helps you get relief in a way that is safer and more comfortable.

What a Prenatal Chiropractor in Bountiful Really Does

Prenatal chiropractic care focuses on the spine, pelvis, and nervous system using gentle adjustments. At a prenatal visit, we use special tables or pillows that give your belly space and protect your joints. The goal is to support better alignment and motion, not to force anything.

A prenatal chiropractor in Bountiful may help with:

Low back pain that feels sharp or catches with movement

Sciatica: that zinging pain that can run from the hip down the legs

Pelvic pain or a feeling that the pelvis is not moving evenly

Rib or mid-back discomfort from your changing posture

Round ligament tension, often felt as sharp tugs low in the belly

Posture-related headaches from tight neck and shoulder muscles

When joints move better and the spine and pelvis are more balanced, many people notice benefits beyond simple pain relief. These can include:

Easier movement for walking, light exercise, and daily tasks

Less strain when getting in and out of bed or the car

Better sleep because it is easier to find a comfortable position

Less overall tension on the uterus and supporting ligaments

Some chiropractors also use pregnancy-safe methods, such as the Webster Technique, that focus on pelvic balance. A more balanced pelvis may support baby in finding a good position for birth, although every body and every pregnancy is different.

How Prenatal Massage Supports Your Changing Body

Prenatal massage is different from a regular massage in a few important ways. Instead of lying flat on your belly, you are usually positioned on your side with pillows, or on a special cushion that supports your chest and hips while leaving space for your belly. Pressure is adjusted to your comfort level, and certain pressure points and areas are approached with care, especially as your due date gets closer.

Prenatal massage can be especially helpful for:

Easing tight muscles in the low back, hips, legs, and shoulders

Calming the nervous system when stress and worry build up

Supporting circulation to help with swelling in hands and feet

Giving you a quiet space to relax and reset emotionally

Massage focuses mainly on soft tissues, like muscles and fascia. It is wonderful for melting tension, but it is not meant to correct joint alignment or pelvic balance on its own. If your discomfort is coming from how your joints are moving or how your pelvis is stacked, massage can help you feel better, but the root problem may still be there.

Prenatal Chiropractor or Massage: How to Choose

So how do you know if you need a prenatal chiropractor in Bountiful or a prenatal massage session first? A simple guide is to pay attention to how your pain feels and when it shows up.

Chiropractic care is often a better fit when:

Pain feels sharp, pinched, or “stuck”

It flares with certain movements, like rolling over, standing up, or walking

You notice pelvic instability, clicking, or shooting sciatic pain

You feel uneven, like one hip is higher or your walk has changed a lot

Prenatal massage is often the better choice when:

Discomfort feels like overall tightness or heaviness

You feel sore from long days on your feet or sitting at a desk

Stress, worry, or poor sleep are making your body feel tense

You want emotional and physical relaxation at the same time

The good news is you usually do not have to pick only one. Chiropractic care can help restore alignment and movement, while massage relaxes the muscles that are attached to those joints. When muscles are more relaxed, adjustments can feel easier and sometimes hold longer. Many people find a rhythm that blends both, based on how they feel week to week.

Always talk with your OB or midwife if you have a high-risk pregnancy, a history of complications, or any new symptoms that concern you. Trusted prenatal providers in Bountiful should be happy to coordinate with your birth team so your care is as safe and supportive as possible.

What to Expect at Your First Prenatal Chiropractic Visit

At Elevate Wellness Chiro, a first prenatal visit is calm, slow, and focused on your story. We start with a detailed health and pregnancy history, including your due date, past pregnancies, and any current concerns. We talk about your daily routine, how you sleep, how you move, and what your goals are for comfort and activity.

Next, we do a gentle posture and movement assessment. This might include:

Watching how you stand, walk, and sit

Lightly checking how different parts of your spine and pelvis move

Noting areas of tightness, tenderness, or restriction

Adjustments are always tailored to your trimester and comfort level. Early in pregnancy, we focus on overall balance and easing any long-standing tension. During mid-pregnancy, we often pay extra attention to the mid-back, ribs, and pelvis as your belly grows. In the third trimester, care usually centers on creating as much space and ease as possible in the low back and pelvis so you can stay mobile.

We use pregnancy-specific tables and pillows, avoid twisting or harsh movements, and check in with you throughout each visit. You are always in charge of your body, and we adjust the pace and techniques so you feel supported, not overwhelmed.

Feeling Better Before Baby in Bountiful

You do not have to push through back pain, pelvic pressure, or sleepless nights just because you are pregnant. With school schedules, work, and baby prep all happening at once, your body deserves as much support as your to-do list.

Whether you lean toward prenatal chiropractic care, prenatal massage, or a thoughtful mix of both, the goal is the same: more comfort, more freedom to move, and a bit more ease in these final weeks. At Elevate Wellness Chiro in Bountiful and Clinton, we are here to help you understand your options and create a plan that fits your body and your pregnancy.

Support A More Comfortable Pregnancy Starting Now

If you are ready to address pain, improve mobility, and prepare your body for birth in a gentle, natural way, we are here to help. At Elevate Wellness Chiro, we tailor every adjustment to your stage of pregnancy and your specific concerns. Schedule your visit with our prenatal chiropractor in Bountiful so you can move through pregnancy with more confidence and ease. Reach out today to reserve a time that works best for you.

Find Safe Relief From Pregnancy Hip Pain

Pregnancy hip and pelvic pain can make even simple things feel hard. Walking around the house, getting out of the car, or rolling over in bed can send sharp twinges through your low back or belly. As your baby and belly grow, that pressure often increases, especially later in pregnancy.

Knowing what kind of pain you are feeling matters. Sacroiliac, or SI, joint pain and round ligament pain show up in different ways and often respond to different types of care. When we understand the source, we can choose safer, more effective ways to calm it down.

As a pregnancy chiropractor in Bountiful, Utah, we focus on gentle, drug-free support that can be adjusted to each trimester. In this article, we will explain SI joint pain, round ligament pain, simple at-home relief ideas, and clear signs it may be time to get extra help for your hips and pelvis.

SI Joint Pain in Pregnancy Explained

Your SI joints sit where your spine meets your pelvis, near the “dimples” in your low back. During pregnancy, hormones help soften your ligaments so your pelvis can open for birth. That softening, combined with weight gain and posture changes, can leave the SI joints irritated and inflamed.

Typical SI joint pain can feel like:

Aching or sharp pain near one dimple of the low back

Pain that worsens when standing up from a chair

Discomfort climbing stairs or walking long distances

Pain when rolling in bed or getting in and out of the car

Many people notice the pain more on one side, although it can switch sides or feel like it wraps around into the outer hip or even the groin. Activities that load one side of the body, such as carrying an older child on one hip or walking on uneven ground, may make it flare up.

As seasons change and you are doing more around the house or yard, extra lifting and bending can put more strain on the SI joints. Long periods of standing at work, cooking, or folding laundry can do the same.

Gentle prenatal chiropractic care often focuses on:

Helping the pelvis sit in a more balanced position

Reducing irritation in the SI joints

Teaching simple stabilizing exercises to support the area

Improving how your hips and low back move together

When the SI joints move more smoothly, many pregnant patients find walking, sleeping, and daily tasks feel more comfortable.

How Round Ligament Pain Feels Different

Round ligament pain starts in a different place. The round ligaments are cord-like bands that run from the sides of your uterus down into your groin. As your uterus grows in the second and third trimesters, these ligaments stretch and can get irritated.

Round ligament pain usually feels like:

Sudden, sharp, or stabbing twinges in the lower belly or groin

Quick zaps of pain with fast movements, like standing up or turning

A pull or catch when coughing, sneezing, or laughing

Brief stabs when rolling over in bed or getting out of the car

Unlike SI joint pain, which often sits deep in the low back or buttock, round ligament pain is more in the front and sides of the lower abdomen or into the groin. It is usually short-lived and very position-related. You might feel a quick jab, then it fades once you stop that motion or change positions.

As your baby grows and you stay active, those twinges can happen more often, which can be frustrating or even scary. The good news is that round ligament pain is common in pregnancy and is usually not a sign of something dangerous. It is still important to bring it up with your prenatal provider so they can rule out other causes.

Gentle bodywork, light stretching, and improving how you move can often decrease how intense and how frequent those sharp tugs feel.

Safe at-Home Relief for Hip and Pelvic Pain

While every pregnancy is unique, there are simple habits that are often helpful for both SI joint and round ligament discomfort.

Daily movement tips:

Change positions slowly instead of making quick, jerking moves

Keep your feet hip-width apart when standing up or turning

Avoid staying in one position for too long, whether sitting or standing

Use a pillow between your knees and ankles when sleeping on your side

In the evenings, set aside a few minutes for gentle, pregnancy-safe moves, such as:

Pelvic tilts on hands and knees, moving your low back in a small, smooth range

Supported child's pose with your chest resting on stacked pillows or a couch

Light hip-opening stretches using a chair or wall for balance, staying in a pain-free range

Simple tools and habits can also make a big difference:

A soft maternity support belt to help take pressure off your belly and pelvis

Warm, not hot, showers or compresses to relax tight muscles

Ice packs over the back of the hips or SI joints for 10 to 15 minutes after activity

Supportive, non-slip shoes for walking on sidewalks, trails, and parking lots

Avoid any deep twisting or aggressive stretching, especially of the low back or pelvis. This can pull on already stressed ligaments. Skip new intense workouts unless cleared by your prenatal provider. If any activity increases your pain, causes cramping, dizziness, or makes you feel “off,” stop and rest.

When to See a Pregnancy Chiropractor in Bountiful, Utah

Home care is helpful, but it is not always enough. It may be time to seek more support if:

Your hip or pelvic pain is getting worse instead of better

Sleep is hard because you cannot find a comfortable position

Walking, working, or caring for other children is becoming difficult

You start avoiding normal daily activities due to pain

There are also times when you need immediate medical attention instead of, or before, chiropractic care. Contact your prenatal provider or seek urgent care if you notice:

Sudden, severe pelvic or abdominal pain

Vaginal bleeding or leaking fluid

Regular contractions or strong tightening of the belly

Fever, chills, or feeling very unwell

Leg weakness, numbness, or trouble controlling your bladder or bowel

When it is safe to do so, a pregnancy chiropractor can be part of your care team. In our Bountiful office, we use gentle, pregnancy-specific techniques and tables designed to support a growing belly. The goal is to reduce stress on your SI joints and ligaments, ease muscle tension, and help your pelvis move in a more balanced way.

We also pay close attention to your stage of pregnancy, health history, and daily routine. Coordination with your OB or midwife helps keep your care plan safe and clear, and helps make sure everyone is working toward the same goals for you and your baby.

Take the Next Step Toward a More Comfortable Pregnancy

You do not have to simply “push through” hip and pelvic pain during pregnancy. Your comfort, mobility, and peace of mind matter, and they affect how you feel as you prepare to meet your baby.

At Elevate Wellness Chiropractic, we help pregnant patients in Bountiful and nearby communities sort out what is coming from the SI joints, what may be round ligament pain, and what else might be going on. A simple way to start is to use the home strategies above and keep a brief pain journal for a few days, noting where it hurts, what makes it worse, and what helps. Sharing those notes with a pregnancy chiropractor in Bountiful, Utah, can lead to more targeted, thoughtful care so you can stay active and enjoy this season with greater ease.

Support Your Pregnancy Journey With Gentle, Personalized Chiropractic Care

If you are ready to ease discomfort and support your changing body, we are here to help you feel more comfortable throughout every trimester. At Elevate Wellness Chiro, we provide individualized care that is tailored to your pregnancy, your goals, and your birth plan. Schedule an appointment with our pregnancy chiropractor in Bountiful, Utah today so we can partner with you in creating a smoother, more supported pregnancy experience.

How Natural Chiropractic Care Can Help Your Child Thrive

Parents in Davis County are paying closer attention to how their kids feel, move, and grow. Many are adding gentle, natural options to support their child’s health along with regular doctor visits. Pediatric chiropractic care is one of those options that often raises curious questions.

Pediatric chiropractic focuses on helping a child’s body move well and stay comfortable as they grow. It uses a light touch to support the spine, joints, and nervous system, which are all working hard during childhood. If you are wondering whether a pediatric chiropractor in Bountiful, Utah is right for your child, it helps to understand what care looks like, how safety is handled, and when it might make sense for your family.

What Pediatric Chiropractic Care Really Is

Pediatric chiropractic care is not just adult care in a smaller body. Kids are not miniature adults, and their care should reflect that. The techniques, timing, and even the way we talk with them are all adapted to match their age and stage of development.

Some key differences in pediatric care include:

Lighter pressure that may feel like a gentle tap or soft touch

Positions that are more comfortable for wiggly bodies

Shorter visits when needed to match their attention span

Simple, kid-friendly explanations so they feel safe

At Elevate Wellness Chiro, a first visit with a child is relaxed and unhurried. We start by talking with parents about:

Health history and any past injuries

Birth history, if it is relevant

Current concerns like posture, movement, or discomfort

Goals, such as easier movement, better comfort, or support during sports

We also look at how your child stands, walks, bends, and plays. We may check posture, gentle ranges of motion, and how the spine and nearby muscles feel. From there, we discuss what we are seeing and whether chiropractic care could be a good fit as part of their overall wellness plan. Chiropractic is meant to work alongside pediatric care from your child’s doctor, not to replace it.

Common goals for pediatric chiropractic care include:

Supporting healthy development and movement patterns

Helping kids feel more comfortable during growth spurts

Addressing small issues early, before they become bigger problems

Working as a natural partner to traditional medical care

Is a Pediatric Chiropractor in Bountiful, Utah Safe for Kids?

Safety is usually the first question parents ask, and it should be. Pediatric chiropractors are trained to work with growing bodies using very gentle, low-force methods. The pressure used for an infant or young child is often lighter than what you might use to test a ripe tomato.

Current professional guidelines support chiropractic care for children when it is provided by a trained, licensed chiropractor who understands pediatric needs. We always encourage clear communication between your child’s healthcare team, including their pediatrician, especially when a child has ongoing medical conditions or complex needs.

At Elevate Wellness Chiro, safety is built into every step of care:

Careful screening for red flags, such as unusual pain, fever, or signs of serious illness, that may need medical attention instead

Customized plans based on age, size, and health history

Frequent check-ins with both the child and parents about comfort levels

Gentle testing of how your child’s body responds, before doing more

If anything seems outside the scope of chiropractic care, we let parents know and encourage follow-up with the appropriate medical provider. Your child’s well-being always comes first.

Common Childhood Issues Chiropractic Care May Support

Modern childhood can be hard on little bodies. Even normal daily activities can create tension or strain over time. Many parents notice small changes in how their child moves or feels before those changes turn into bigger complaints.

Some everyday concerns that may lead parents to consider chiropractic care include:

Slouched posture from long periods on devices or at desks

Sports-related aches after practice or games

Growing pains or stiffness during growth spurts

Tension-type headaches or neck discomfort

Mild discomfort from carrying heavy backpacks

Gentle chiropractic adjustments and soft-tissue work are designed to:

Improve joint motion and overall alignment

Reduce strain on muscles and ligaments

Support a calmer, better-balanced nervous system

Age and stage matter too:

Toddlers are learning to walk and fall often, which can affect how they move.

School-age kids sit more and carry backpacks, which can impact posture.

Teens push their bodies in sports and activities, which can create repetitive strain.

Care plans are tailored to match your child’s stage, activities, and comfort level, so they get only what they need and nothing more.

How Chiropractic Fits with Your Child’s Whole-Body Wellness

Chiropractic care is one piece of your child’s wellness picture, not the whole puzzle. When the spine and joints move well, it can support better comfort, which often affects other parts of daily life.

Chiropractic can fit alongside:

Good sleep habits and calming bedtime routines

Plenty of movement, play, and outdoor time

Healthy ways to handle stress from school, friends, or activities

Immune support during busy seasons like back-to-school or winter

At Elevate Wellness Chiro, we look at the whole child. That often means sharing simple ideas for home, such as:

Basic stretches that are easy to remember

Posture tips for homework, gaming, and device use

Ways to set up a backpack or study space that is kinder to their body

We also recognize that kids are part of a bigger team. Working in harmony with medical providers, coaches, and teachers can help support their comfort, performance, and confidence.

Choosing the Right Pediatric Chiropractor in Bountiful, Utah

Finding a good fit matters just as much as choosing the right type of care. When you look for a pediatric chiropractor in Bountiful, Utah, a simple checklist can help you feel more at ease.

Helpful things to look for include:

Training and experience in caring for children

A clear, kind communication style with both kids and parents

An office that feels calm, welcoming, and child-friendly

A willingness to answer questions without pressure

A focus on collaboration with your child’s other providers

Good questions to ask during an initial visit are:

How do you change your techniques for infants, toddlers, and older kids?

How will you track my child’s progress over time?

How often will you re-check and adjust the care plan?

What signs should I watch for between visits?

At Elevate Wellness Chiro in Davis County, we focus on personalized care plans that look for root-cause issues instead of only chasing symptoms. Our space is designed to feel inviting for the whole family, and our goal is to support your child’s comfort and confidence as they grow.

Support Your Child’s Health With Gentle, Targeted Care

If you are looking for experienced, kid-focused chiropractic support, we are here to help your family feel confident about every stage of growth. At Elevate Wellness Chiro, we take the time to listen, explain each step, and create a calm environment where your child can relax.
